chore(release): 0.0.2 (#35)

Release 0.0.2. The version is set with uv run cz bump --increment PATCH --version-files-only --yes, as AGENTS.md's Releases step 1 says. CHANGELOG.md dates the 0.0.2 entry for the release day, opens it on a lead for a reader new to nustack, and links 0.0.2 and [Unreleased]. The plugin's description names Tomer Nosrati in full, in each manifest and marketplace that holds it.
